theme: Dark Mode Only - Jet Black #0A0A0A base
file_type_notice: The project uses JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files. Ensure imports and JSX syntax are strictly valid JS.

gradients.wordmark_gradient: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#007BA7] via-[#00F0FF] to-[#FF2D95] bg-clip-text text-transparent

typography.font_rules: BANNED: Inter, Roboto, Space Grotesk. Headings must use Rajdhani or Syne with tracking-tight/uppercase editorial flair. Code snippets and technical indicators must use JetBrains Mono.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold uppercase tracking-wide

glassmorphism_tokens.hero_card_glass: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/15 shadow-[0_8px_32px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.37)] backdrop-saturate-150

motion_plan.intro_reveal: 2.8 second cinematic full-screen logo reveal on application load. Black screen -> Cyan/Pink pulse vector logo -> SANKALP'26 text shatter/glitch reveal -> smooth slide-up curtain exit into Neon Girl Hero.
motion_plan.hero_entry: Staggered fade & slide up for editorial typography on left, 3D scale and glow pulse for Neon Girl key art on right.
motion_plan.scroll_reveal: Framer motion opacity 0 -> 1 and translateY(20px -> 0px) with spring physics.
motion_plan.micro_interactions: Glowing tracing borders on hover, scale-95 on button click, HUD cyan scanner line loops across track cards.

landing_page: Cinematic Intro Reveal (2.8s intro animation with state toggle for complete skip)
Floating Glass Navbar (Logo with cyan->pink gradient, links: About, Tracks, Schedule, Prizes, Sponsors, FAQ, CTA 'Register Now')

HUMAN NEXT Style Hero (Left column: Big bold editorial typography, countdown timer to Nov 27, live stats '₹75,000 Prize Pool', '24 Hours', action buttons 'Register Team' and 'Submit Project'. Right column: Neon Girl Cyborg portrait with glowing cyan/pink rim lighting & ambient backdrop beam)
About & Theme Narrative ('The Story of SANKALP'26' - Ideas Today, A Brighter Tomorrow. High contrast grid with HUD badges for IEEE AJIET SB & AJIET Mangalore)

Tracks & Themes Grid (6 interactive bento cards: AI/ML & Cybernetics, Web3 & Decentralized Systems, FinTech & Quantum Commerce, Smart Cities & IoT, Healthcare & MedTech, Open Innovation - with HUD filter & dynamic tags)
24-Hour Hackathon Timeline (Vertical interactive timeline showing Day 1 & Day 2 milestones with live status indicators)
Prize Pool Breakdown (₹75,000 total: 1st ₹35,000, 2nd ₹20,000, 3rd ₹10,000, Best All-Girls Team ₹5,000, Best Beginner Team ₹5,000 with glowing metallic podium cards)
Sponsors & Organizers Section (Bravynex Engineering, Binary Waves, IEEE Mangalore Subsection, AJIET SB with high-gloss monochrome cards & cyan hover state)
FAQs Accordion (Shadcn customized with glowing neon borders & smooth expand)
Footer (Deep jet black with cyan/pink subtle gradient separator, IEEE copyright, quick links, contact address in Mangalore)

portals_and_dashboards.auth_portal: Glassmorphism modal / full page with tabs for Team Registration (Team Name, Leader Email, Password, College, Member details) and Login (Email, Password JWT token store).
portals_and_dashboards.team_submission_portal: HUD dashboard with project status banner, form fields (Project Title, Short Tagline, GitHub Repo URL, Live Demo Link, Video Pitch YouTube URL, Selected Track, Tech Stack tags, Markdown Detailed Description).
portals_and_dashboards.judge_evaluation_portal: Compact data-dense dashboard. Filter submissions by track. Side-by-side split view: Left = submission links & video embed, Right = scoring slider criteria (Innovation 25%, Technical Complexity 25%, Feasibility 25%, UX/Presentation 25%, Total auto-calc) + Comments box + Submit Score button.
portals_and_dashboards.leaderboard_portal: Real-time rank list table with gold/silver/bronze highlight badges, team scores breakdown, live search, track filters, and export option.
portals_and_dashboards.admin_dashboard: Control center with overview stats cards (Total Teams, Submissions, Active Judges, Evaluation Progress %), Team Management table, Judge Allocation modal, Round Control toggle switch (Registration Open -> Hackathon Active -> Evaluation Phase -> Winner Announcement).

data_testid_conventions.rule: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, links, forms, tabs, and key metrics MUST have data-testid in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts 'Rajdhani', 'Syne', and 'JetBrains Mono' in index.html or index.css.
Enforce Jet Black (#0A0A0A) background globally and prevent light-theme white flashes.
Implement the 2.8s full-screen intro animation with Framer Motion, persisting 'hasSeenIntro' in sessionStorage so reloads feel smooth.
Build the hero with the HUMAN NEXT editorial dual-column layout: text left, cyberpunk neon girl right with cyan/pink glassmorphism filters.
Ensure all forms use mock/JWT local storage logic so full end-to-end registration, submission, judge scoring, and admin controls work seamlessly.
Ensure every interactive element has a proper data-testid attribute.
Strictly avoid 'Inter' or 'Space Grotesk' fonts for headings.
